name: Yukimiya Nanaka
source:
[url=/c70330]Kouko's[/url] best friend and a second-year high school student at the same school. A modest girl who had a promising future in the medical industry as both of her parents are doctors, however she was unwilling to be bound by their expectations and went down a completely different path.

As the new semester rolls on, the rumors about Nanaka participating in compensated dating begin to circulate even further...
